topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I can't help but think about the last time I was there, how I could have come more often, maybe brought more people along. It’s not just the food that’s going to be missed, it’s the whole place—the ambiance, the staff who knew my order before I even opened my menu. Now I keep wondering if my visits could have made a difference, if perhaps showing up more might have helped. But the signs are up, and the dates are set. I’ll have to find a new spot for my favorite dish, and it won’t be the same. The city will have a little less personality without this place.
